d: Two families, both whom have never met, have agreed that the Wives will swap homes, children and husbands for two weeks to see what they can learn from their own lives.

t: Rock of Love: Hustle on the Bustle
d: Twice unlucky in love, this time Bret Michaels leaves his mansion behind and takes twenty even more beautiful babes on tour with him to find a girlfriend who can handle his life on the road.

t: Rock of Love: Fifteen Weddings And Three Funerals
d: Fifteen girls take turns reciting their own wedding vows to Bret.

t: Rock of Love: Babes On Ice
d: Bret is looking for a woman with maternal instincts, so he puts his twelve girls in ice skates to see how well they protect Baby Bret against the University of Illinois Women's Hockey Team and special guest player, Lacey.
Bret Michaels has a concert tonight. Ten girls compete to see who can clear the band's equipment off the stage the fastest.

t: Rock of Love: Eight Is Not Enough
d: The eight remaining girls get a distressing wake-up call when Bret brings in three new girls to join the tour because he's not feeling the emotional effort.
It's Pink Bus vs. Blue Bus in the muddiest of Mudbowls yet! Bret flies away with the MVP for an intimate overnight trip.

t: Rock of Love: Truck Stop Games
d: In a wacky competition based on beer, babes and truckers, one team will try anything to sway the judges.

t: Rock of Love: Bikini Day Care
d: The tour hits Panama City Beach, Florida. Seven girls show their mothering skills by taking care of a gaggle of rowdy youngsters at the pool.

t: Rock of Love: Exes and Ohs!
d: Secrets come out when Bret invites his ex-girlfriend Ambre and Rock of Love alum Heather to interrogate the remaining six girl's exes.

t: Rock of Love: Duet To Me One More Time
st: Duet To Me One More Time
d: Four girls are challenged to write lyrics to one of Bret's songs and sing with him.
Bret plans a couple of fantasy dates for his last three girls, but when one girl gets to go twice, the other two are worried that Bret has already made his final decision.

t: Rock of Love: Brets Rock of Love III
d: Bret takes his final two girls to the Dominican Republic to spend some quality, romantic time with each one before making his final choice.

t: Rock of Love: Rock of Love Girls Where Are They Now?
st: Rock of Love Girls Where Are They Now?
d: What the hell happened to all those girls?  From actress to artist, scholar to show girl, prom queen to porn star, they've all gone on to bigger and better things.

t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
d: Every buddy needs somebody and Vinny is ready for love. After seeing love spark for Pauly and Nikki, Vinny is willing to try this crazy experiment all over again. But when he meets the ladies will his nerves get the best of him?

t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
st: Say Hello To My Ex, Maria
d: Pauly and Nikki have a not so welcome surprise for Vinny, a visit from his ex, Maria. Sparks will fly but will they be the good kind or the bad kind. Vinny shares a kiss with someone special.
